day_shape: 58 items: Trump says Iran decision coming "very soon" with Netanyahu reportedly discussing renewed strikes, Houthi-Saudi fight escalates with Aramco HQ targeted, OFAC publishes Iran sector determination, Iran executes mountaineer Mostafavi, UK-Iran row over RAF Fairford plot deepens.

threads.label: Trump Iran decision and Hormuz pressure
threads.summary: Trump told reporters a decision on Iran is coming "very soon" and warned "wait and see," while Jerusalem Post reported Netanyahu and Trump discussed a renewed military campaign against Iran before both countries' elections. CENTCOM rebutted an IRGC navy commander's claim that the Strait of Hormuz is under IRGC control, and Iran International reported Tehran escalating tanker attacks ahead of US midterms.

threads.label: Houthi-Saudi escalation and Aramco strikes
threads.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi missiles aimed at Aramco's Dhahran headquarters and confirmed strikes on a Yemeni oil facility in Sanaa, while the Houthis vowed to continue hitting Saudi airports and oil sites. Trump said the Houthis are "behaving very badly" and Israeli defense officials reportedly raised preparations for a possible Houthi surprise attack.

threads.label: UK-Iran row over RAF Fairford plot
threads.summary: Iran summoned Britain's ambassador and threatened to reconsider diplomatic ties after London blamed the IRGC for a suspected plot against a US-used airbase. The UK's domestic spy chief said Iran is escalating attempts to hit military sites in Britain.

threads.label: Iran executions and domestic repression
threads.summary: Iranian authorities executed 38-year-old mountaineer Ali-Sina Mostafavi and a monarchist convicted of wartime armed attacks, per judiciary outlet Mizan. Amnesty International condemned the execution of five protest-linked men in one week and called for coordinated international pressure on Tehran.

threads.label: Gaza anniversary and Lebanon front
threads.summary: The State Department marked one year since the Sharm el-Sheikh Gaza Peace Summit as US officials prepared a Gaza mapping operation for Hamas weapons surrender under Trump's 20-point plan, and the IDF said it killed Hamas commander Mumen al-Ay in Gaza City. In Lebanon, the IDF located Hezbollah explosives near Kfar Shouba, and reports said Hezbollah is rebuilding drones and announced up to $14,000 in housing aid following alleged Iranian cash transfers.

events.title: A Hamas commander who held hostages in captivity during the war was killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza City yesterday, the military announces. The IDF says the strike killed Mumen Ahmad Salameh al-Ay, a commander and aide to senior officers in Hamas's Gaza City Brigade. During the war, al-Ay held hostages in the Gaza City area, the military says, without identifying the captives. The military says that recently, al-Ay was advancing attacks against troops and Israeli civilians and attempted to restore Hamas capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."
events.summary:
A Hamas commander who held hostages in captivity during the war was killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza City yesterday, the military announces.

The IDF says the strike killed Mumen Ahmad Salameh al-Ay, a commander and aide to senior officers in Hamas's Gaza City Brigade.

During the war, al-Ay held hostages in the Gaza City area, the military says, without identifying the captives.

The military says that recently, al-Ay was advancing attacks against troops and Israeli civilians and attempted to restore Hamas capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."
